course.title: PMP® Exam Preparation and Business Application
course.audience: Experienced project leaders, program and portfolio professionals, transformation leaders, military and government project practitioners, and candidates preparing for the July 2026 Project Management Professional (PMP) examination
course.description: An independent, AI-native, self-paced Obserra Academy program aligned to the public July 2026 PMP Examination Content Outline. The course provides 35 hours of Project Professional training through cinematic instruction, evidence-grounded project scenarios, original practice questions, business application workshops, a governed AI tutor, and a full 180-question readiness simulation. Obserra is not representing this course as official PMI courseware, a PMI Authorized Training Partner offering, or a guarantee of examination eligibility or success. Learners remain responsible for confirming current PMI eligibility and training requirements before applying.
prerequisites: Review the current PMI PMP certification eligibility requirements before enrollment
Professional experience leading or supporting projects is strongly recommended
Access to the current PMI Examination Content Outline and legally acquired project management reference materials
Agreement to the Obserra Academy assessment integrity and AI tutor use policy
outcomes: Explain the July 2026 PMP examination structure, eligibility paths, domain weights, question style, and training requirements using current PMI sources.
Apply people leadership, stakeholder engagement, communication, conflict, and knowledge-transfer practices in predictive, adaptive, and hybrid project environments.
Develop and manage integrated plans, scope, value, resources, procurement, finance, quality, schedules, metrics, and closure decisions.
Establish governance, compliance, change control, issue management, risk management, continuous improvement, organizational change, and external-environment monitoring.
Analyze scenario-based questions by identifying the project context, the project manager's authority, the most immediate problem, the best next action, and the evidence needed to verify the outcome.

Translate PMP-aligned practices into usable business artifacts including a charter, stakeholder strategy, delivery approach, risk register, integrated schedule, benefits measures, governance model, and executive briefing.

Use AI responsibly to support planning, analysis, communication, risk identification, and lessons learned while preserving human accountability, confidentiality, source verification, and decision authority.
Complete an original 180-question simulation and produce an evidence-based study and exam-readiness plan without using exam dumps or confidential examination content.

modules.title: Course Orientation, PMP Eligibility, Ethics, and Independent Preparation
modules.description: Verify the current certification pathway, understand the 35-hour training requirement, distinguish Obserra's independent preparation from official PMI courseware, and establish assessment-integrity and study-governance expectations.

modules.title: 2026 Exam Architecture and Scenario-Based Reasoning
modules.description: Analyze the 180-question, 240-minute examination, domain weighting, predictive and adaptive distribution, and the decision logic required for experience-based scenario questions.

modules.title: People Domain: Develop and Sustain a Common Vision
modules.description: Build, communicate, test, and refresh a shared project vision while diagnosing misunderstandings and connecting the vision to outcomes and stakeholder value.

modules.title: People Domain: Manage Conflict and Ground Rules
modules.description: Identify conflict sources, analyze context, select a proportionate resolution strategy, and reinforce team ground rules without avoiding or prematurely escalating the conflict.

modules.title: People Domain: Lead and Empower the Project Team
modules.description: Tailor leadership style, clarify roles, remove barriers, represent the team, empower decision making, and use diverse skills and perspectives to improve outcomes.

modules.title: People Domain: Engage Stakeholders
modules.description: Identify and analyze stakeholders, tailor communication, build trust, execute the engagement plan, and optimize alignment between stakeholder needs and project objectives.

modules.title: People Domain: Align Stakeholder Expectations
modules.description: Categorize stakeholders, surface competing expectations, facilitate alignment, and create mentoring opportunities that strengthen shared understanding and commitment.

modules.title: People Domain: Manage Customer and Stakeholder Expectations
modules.description: Maintain outcome alignment, monitor satisfaction, respond to changes, and distinguish expectation management from ungoverned scope acceptance.

modules.title: People Domain: Ensure Knowledge Transfer
modules.description: Identify critical project knowledge, capture it at the point of work, foster transfer across teams, and prevent operational dependence on undocumented individuals.

modules.title: People Domain: Plan Communication, Reporting, and Feedback
modules.description: Define a communication strategy, support transparency, establish feedback loops, tailor reports, and connect project communications to governance and sponsor decisions.

modules.title: Process Domain: Develop the Integrated Plan and Delivery Approach
modules.description: Assess complexity, select predictive, adaptive, or hybrid delivery, estimate effort and resources, integrate dependencies, maintain the plan, and use data to support decisions.

modules.title: Process Domain: Develop and Manage Scope
modules.description: Define product and project scope, obtain agreement, decompose work, manage backlog boundaries, and differentiate clarification from uncontrolled scope expansion.

modules.title: Process Domain: Ensure Value-Based Delivery
modules.description: Identify value components, prioritize work, deliver value incrementally, measure benefits, and evaluate options based on outcomes rather than activity completion alone.

modules.title: Process Domain: Plan and Manage Resources
modules.description: Define resource needs, assess capacity and constraints, optimize availability, negotiate competing demands, and connect resource decisions to schedule and value.

modules.title: Process Domain: Plan and Manage Procurement
modules.description: Develop a procurement strategy, select contract approaches, participate in negotiation, monitor suppliers, evaluate performance, and verify agreement objectives.

modules.title: Process Domain: Plan and Manage Project Finance
modules.description: Analyze financial needs, establish reserves, quantify risk allowances, monitor variance, forecast challenges, and communicate financial implications through governance.

modules.title: Process Domain: Optimize Quality, Compliance, and Sustainability
modules.description: Translate quality and regulatory requirements into controls, manage cost of quality, conduct reviews, and improve deliverables without treating compliance as a final inspection.

modules.title: Process Domain: Plan and Manage the Schedule
modules.description: Build an integrated schedule, estimate work, map dependencies, identify the critical path, use historical data, baseline the plan, and analyze schedule variance.

modules.title: Process Domain: Evaluate Status, Metrics, and Artifacts
modules.description: Select decision-useful metrics, maintain accessible artifacts, reconcile status, communicate evidence and uncertainty, and avoid dashboards that conceal weak source data.

modules.title: Process Domain: Close the Project or Phase and Transition Outcomes
modules.description: Confirm completion criteria, obtain approval, validate operational readiness, close contracts and finances, release resources, and preserve lessons learned and benefits ownership.

modules.title: Business Environment: Define and Establish Project Governance
modules.description: Design decision rights, reporting, ethics, policies, success metrics, escalation thresholds, and governance forums proportionate to project risk and organizational context.

modules.title: Business Environment: Plan and Manage Compliance
modules.description: Identify applicable security, health, safety, sustainability, regulatory, contractual, and policy requirements; evaluate consequences; implement controls; and measure compliance evidence.

modules.title: Business Environment: Manage and Control Changes
modules.description: Evaluate proposed changes, use the approved control process, communicate status, implement authorized changes, and update baselines and artifacts without obstructing adaptive delivery.

modules.title: Business Environment: Remove Impediments and Manage Issues
modules.description: Distinguish risks from issues, assess impact, prioritize obstacles, collaborate on interventions, and verify that impediments are actually removed rather than merely reassigned.

modules.title: Business Environment: Plan and Manage Risk
modules.description: Identify, analyze, prioritize, respond to, monitor, and communicate project threats and opportunities, including cybersecurity and sustainability risk.

modules.title: Business Environment: Drive Continuous Improvement
modules.description: Use retrospectives and lessons learned to change behavior, improve organizational process assets, and verify that improvement actions are implemented and measured.

modules.title: Business Environment: Support Organizational Change
modules.description: Assess culture, readiness, adoption, resistance, and operational impact, then integrate project delivery with communication, training, sponsorship, and reinforcement.

modules.title: Business Environment: Evaluate External Environment Changes
modules.description: Monitor regulatory, technological, geopolitical, market, supply-chain, and environmental changes and translate them into backlog, scope, risk, governance, and value decisions.

modules.title: Integrated Ways of Working: Predictive, Adaptive, and Hybrid Tailoring
modules.description: Tailor governance, planning, delivery, metrics, and controls to the work while preparing for an exam mix of approximately 40 percent predictive and 60 percent adaptive or hybrid scenarios.

modules.title: Integrated Practice: AI, Sustainability, Stakeholder Value, and Business Impact
modules.description: Apply the 2026 emphasis on AI, sustainability, stakeholder engagement, outcomes, value, and business impact while preserving evidence quality, privacy, accountability, and professional judgment.

modules.title: Business Application Capstone and Evidence-Based Exam Readiness
modules.description: Lead an enterprise transformation scenario from charter through transition, produce executive artifacts, analyze personal performance, and create a targeted readiness plan.

modules.title: Protected Practice Examination: Section One
modules.description: Complete 60 original, timed, scenario-based questions across all three domains without AI assistance, then receive domain-level performance feedback after submission.

modules.title: Protected Practice Examination: Section Two
modules.description: Complete the second 60-question timed section with predictive, adaptive, and hybrid situations, followed by evidence-grounded remediation guidance.

modules.title: Protected Practice Examination: Section Three and Final Readiness Review
modules.description: Complete the final 60-question timed section and produce a documented readiness decision, weak-domain recovery plan, exam-day strategy, and continuing business-application plan.
